measurement.share: As E181: E57's re-gating share (K00 - K01) / (K00 - K11), cells summed over a row set's 128 rows of 256 tokens, status by commute.qwen_reading.shares, on the frozen-neuron decomposition p-015e0710 (subcomponents fixed at the MLP neurons, only Gamma trained, MLP matrices only)
measurement.size: As E181: K00, mean KL per position over the 128 rows between the changed model and the original subcomponents under W0's masks. Searched on the first 32 rows as K00 - K0 to within 1.05x; a read is 'matched' when its 128-row K00 is within 1.1x of its target
measurement.sizes: As E181, from P3.9 run2's fine-tunes per row set: low = their lowest K00, high = their highest, mid = sqrt(low x high). Built changes at mid; random draws at all three
measurement.built_change: E181's three orders of the used pool (same usage, same 10% pool per layer, same interleave over the 28 layers, same seeds: top, random, specific; commute.share_reference.orders), with a continuous size x: the gate_proj rows of the first floor(x) neurons of the order zeroed (dW = -W0 there) and the next neuron's row multiplied by 1 - frac(x) (dW = -frac(x) W0 there), zero elsewhere (share_reference.turned_down, built_change). Each neuron is one subcomponent of p-015e0710, so the change is a mask on each subcomponent it touches: 0 on floor(x) of them, 1 - frac(x) on the next. x is searched by commute.share_reading.size_search, not whole, power 1, from 28, at most the pool, up to 20 evaluations (E181: whole counts, 8). All 15 (5 row sets x 3 orders) are read again; none is kept from E181. Each record holds x, the whole count floor(x), the partial factor 1 - frac(x) (null when frac(x) = 0) and the neuron list
measurement.random_change: As E181: iid Gaussian on the 84 MLP matrices (seed null_seed(d, site)) at the per-matrix norms of the row set's seed-0 late fine-tune, times one scale b searched per size so K00 lands at low, mid and high, one split per draw. Draws 0, 1, 2 are E181's reads (experiments/qwen_share_reference/results/random/*.json) as they stand; draws 3, 4, 5 are read here by the same code (commute.share_reference.random_draw, moved from E181's run.py unchanged)
measurement.curve: As E181, over all six draws: per row set, per size level with at least two usable draws (scored and matched), the point (geometric mean K00, mean share); linear in log K00 between levels; a K00 outside the span by at most 1.1x takes the nearest end's share (share_reading.curve, at)
measurement.band: As E181, over all six draws: per row set, the largest distance of a usable random draw's share from the curve at its own K00 (share_reading.band). Measured in this job, not guessed
measurement.placement: As E181: gap = share minus the curve at its own K00; 'above' if gap > band, 'below' if gap < -band, 'inside' otherwise (rounded to 9 places, a gap equal to the band is inside); 'unreadable' if the reading is not usable (not scored, or for a built change not matched), its share is not finite, the curve has no value at its K00 or there is no band (share_reading.place)
measurement.blind_to: As E181: the share reads only how much of the change's output effect the original neurons recover under Gamma's masks on the changed model's forward; it cannot tell which neurons moved. The built change tests switching neurons off (and one turned down partway) only; switching on cannot be built this way. Attention matrices are left unchanged by every change. The band is a maximum over up to 18 draws, so it grows with the number of draws: six draws widen it against E181's three unless the curve moves towards the outliers
measurement.positive_control: The built change is the share's positive control: a switching-off by construction. The do-nothing state (share 1 by construction) checks the split path only
measurement.noise_floor: The band, from six random draws per size on each row set. For the card: P3.9 run2's seed sd of a fine-tune's share, largest 0.0063, pooled 0.0030

controls_stop_on_miss.W0: Stage 0, first and alone, per row set the job reads, on its first 16 rows: W0 as the changed model, K00 and K01 equal K0, an all-zero split's K10 and K11 equal K0, each within 1e-6 relative
controls_stop_on_miss.do_nothing: Stage 0, once per job: the do-nothing state of random draw 0 at scale 100 on the job's first row set's 16 rows through the split path: share within 1e-6 of 1
controls_stop_on_miss.K0_floor: Every read: its mean K0 over 128 rows equals experiments/qwen_library_share/results/p-015e0710/floors.json .floors.<rowset>.K0 within 1e-3 relative
controls_stop_on_miss.alive: The Lab stops unless the live set rebuilt from p-015e0710's W0 g statistics counts 516,092
controls_stop_on_miss.e181_draws: The job stops before stage 0 unless E181's draws 0-2 at the three sizes are on disk for every row set it reads
controls_stop_on_miss.stored_error: As E181: each split's fp32 X within 1e-3 of float64, in ||dW||_Sigma
controls_stop_on_miss.gpu: As E181: peak under 44 GiB after the first row of each cell pass

expected.built_x: Where E181's whole count matched in size (copy, cipher, known, invented and gold 'random'; known, invented and gold 'specific'), x within a few neurons of its count; where a giant neuron sat between two counts (all five 'top' orders: between 1 and 4; cipher 'specific' between 278 and 288, copy 'specific' between 193 and 203), x inside that neuron with a partial factor between 0 and 1

expected.random_scale: b between about 0.7x the smallest and 1.3x the largest of E181's draws 0-2 at the same size on the same row set (E181's three draws spread up to 1.5x: known low 36-55)

rules.built: As E181: share_reading.outcome over the 15 built reads (5 row sets x 3 orders), min readable 9, fraction 0.8: 'above random' (rival A) if at least 80% of the readable reads are 'above'; 'like random' (rival B) if at least 80% are 'inside'; 'below random' if at least 80% are 'below'; 'mixed' otherwise; 'unreadable' under 9 readable. Counts per order are reported beside it, not scored
rules.finetunes: As E181: share_reading.outcome over P3.9's 36 read fine-tunes, each placed on its own row set's six-draw curve at its own K00, min readable 27, fraction 0.8. A description: no reuse or new label follows from it
